## Issues Found

1. **Unclear target UI** – “Style overrides” and “layout buttons” aren’t tied to concrete names or screens. Specify the UI location (e.g. “sidebar in the Hero entry,” “field ‘layout’ in the app”) or add a screenshot so the right elements are changed.
2. **Success criteria for (3)** – “Change the content respectively” is ambiguous. Clarify the expected behavior (e.g. “Left / Center / Right buttons should move the hero headline and CTA to that alignment” or “Layout A/B/C should switch between predefined hero layouts”).
3. **Three changes in one prompt** – The prompt is still workable, but ordering or phasing helps (e.g. “Fix in this order: 1) height, 2) Forma-36, 3) button behavior”) so implementation matches your priority.

## Refined Prompt

Use this (or paste it and add the bracketed bits):

---

See the Contentful app we built; details are in the README.

Please fix three things:

**1. Height**  
The app iframe/container is too small, so I have to scroll inside the entry to see everything. Increase the height so it uses 100% of the content (or full viewport) and I don’t have to scroll inside the entry.

**2. Styling**  
Style the app so it looks like a native Contentful UI: use Forma-36 components and tokens so it doesn’t look like a custom app.

**3. Layout buttons / style overrides**  
The [style overrides / layout] controls [e.g. in the sidebar or in field X] have buttons [e.g. “Left”, “Center”, “Right” or “Layout A/B/C”]. Clicking them does not change the hero. I expect each button to change the position/layout of the text [and optionally media] on the hero. Please wire these buttons so they update the hero content accordingly [e.g. “Left = text left-aligned, Center = centered, Right = right-aligned” or describe the exact layouts you want].

**Success criteria:**  
- No scrolling inside the entry to see the full app.  
- App looks like Contentful (Forma-36).  
- Each layout/override button changes the hero layout/position as intended [add your specific expectations if you have them].
